description: The earlier real-photo pair (docs/REAL_WORLD_EVAL.md): every MegaDepth-X photo of the Florence Baptistry (component 1) and Aachen Cathedral (component 1) whose own EXIF carries GPS, with the dataset's reference poses. Centres and outlines from eval/landmarks.json (OSM footprint centroids, not the Wikipedia coordinate the earlier Baptistry runs used).
licence: Photos: Wikimedia Commons, each under its own licence (per photo; MegaDepth-X license.parquet). Reference SfM models: MegaDepth-X, CC BY 4.0. Outlines: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Only metadata is committed; photos and anything derived from them stay outside the repository.
materialise: python -I scripts/benchmark.py prepare --testset mdx-two-v1 [--mdx-local <slug>=<extracted component dir>]

schema_notes.buildings[].photos[]: only photos whose own EXIF carries GPS; file = path under <data-root>/<testset_id>/<slug>; sha256 = of that file (the MegaDepth-X image, ~1000 px); exif_sha256 = of its EXIF APP1 payload (the dataset keeps GPS, compass and capture time but drops focal length and camera model); source.member = path in the archive; author/author_url = from the Commons description page where known, else null; original_url = the Commons original the dataset image was made from; thumbnail_width null (not a thumbnail)
schema_notes.buildings[].gt_reference: MegaDepth-X component model; images maps photo key -> reference image name and that image's EXIF orientation; materialised under <data-root>/<testset_id>/<slug>/gt/<component>/sparse
